items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (surge damaged, replaced like-for-like)
items.rationale: The living-room unit is a fixed, permanently wired installation serving the building, damaged by insured overvoltage (2.3.3). Like-for-like replacement is covered (7.1.9), and the unit is not within 5m of a cooking appliance, so the kitchen exclusion (2.3.10(c)) does not apply. Reference Case 15 (speaker system: t = 389–525) and Case 33 (laptop: t = 1220–1472 for a more complex device) suggest a fair threshold for a fixed AC unit is higher, but not excessive.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen (wall-mounted a couple of metres from the hob)
items.rationale: Although the kitchen unit is a fixed installation, 2.3.10(c) specifically excludes overvoltage damage to climate-control equipment installed within 5m of a cooking appliance, measured straight-line. The invoice and photo confirm the unit is within this range. Thus, the entire line is excluded.
Installation of a covered like-for-like replacement is indemnified as part of the necessary repair/replacement cost (7.1.9(c)), as the principal item is covered.
Ancillary charges (installation) follow the principal item (7.1.11). As the kitchen unit itself is excluded by 2.3.10(c), installation is also excluded.

items.description: Floor console (equivalent stand for the living-room unit)
items.rationale: The floor console is a fixed support required for the living-room unit (7.1.9(b)), and the old one was damaged and could not be reused. Covered as part of the necessary replacement.

Ordinary freight for a covered replacement item is indemnified (7.1.9(e), 7.1.12), but only in proportion to the covered items. Here, only the living-room unit and its console are covered (approx. half the total shipment by value), so indemnity is apportioned 50%.
